methods: Fresh PNG rasterization from each actual final PDF using PyMuPDF, whole-page 1.3x and detail 2x (144 dpi).
Read-only Microsoft Word export, Documents.Open ReadOnly true; six protocol DOCX regenerated from unchanged saved snapshots after neutral protocol source freeze.
PDF extracted text compared with form-aware expected saved snapshot values. Whitespace normalized; hyphen line wraps and intra-word cell wraps separately recorded.
DOCX/PDF/snapshot/PNG SHA-256 bind each finding to exact reviewed bytes. Existing overall inventory left unchanged.

resolvedFindings.finding: Source-owned ТОО prefix / ЖШС suffix duplicated saved legal employer text in BIOT protocols.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Fresh final BIOT/ITR PDFs show each actual RU/KZ employer exactly in header and roster, without extra source legal-form words.

resolvedFindings.finding: PTM previously retained RU employer only and source ЖШС suffix.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Fresh final PTM PDFs include complete distinct RU and KZ employer values in header and roster.

minorLayoutObservations.observation: Narrow retained position column wraps Russian производственного between производственно and го without a printed hyphen. All characters are visible; field verification uses whitespace-free comparison for this one wrapped value.
Neutral ЛОГОТИП text is complete, with top/right/bottom frame strokes visible; left stroke is not visible in Word export. Application PDF displays all four strokes. No factual field is affected.

limits: This is technical local rendering acceptance of the listed synthetic fixtures, not legal approval, production registration or a signed issuance.

Only fields represented by each retained source form are asserted: ITR certificate has one RU name and chair, bilingual selected course and RU issue date; PS witness uses bilingual profession/qualification, not a standalone course-name field; protocols use static source subject captions rather than the selected-course string.
Protocol source exposes issuer.nameRu, not a separate issuer.nameKz field; protocol body name is fullNameRu. Neither absent source field is represented as a passed PDF check.
Rendering cannot prove physical printer behavior. Font/engine line-break differences remain, recorded where material.

currentCodeReadback.note: After root added new-policy namespace isolation, all ten saved snapshots were rerendered with current code into a private folder; each DOCX SHA-256 equals the exact reviewed principal DOCX. No geometric or value change.

regressionTest.coverage: 4 individual / 4 group employer contracts, 3 group header overrides; actual duplicate legal words inside user value preserved. PB source has employer only in header.
